name: Love Lagoon
source:
Off the coast of the Florida Keys lies a thriving bay full of mangroves and marine life. As a newly minted marine biology intern, there's no better place to be sent to conduct research! Discover and document a new species of fish, and... uh, guys... I'm pretty sure I just saw some kind of giant shadow in the water... and don't call me crazy, but I think it was kinda hot?!

[From [url=https://chimeraprince.itch.io/love-lagoon-demo]itch.io[/url]]
